~nv3~ Q-7281: How many days are there from 2023-11-24 to 2024-05-31 (count the end date but not the start date)?
Answer: 189

Breakdown (end date included, start date excluded):
- 2023-11-24 to 2023-12-31: 37 days (6 remaining in Nov + 31 in Dec)
- 2024-01-01 to 2024-05-31: 152 days (Jan 31 + Feb 29 (leap) + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31)
Total: 37 + 152 = 189
-- A23
